title: soillifeatlas/soillifeatlas pipeline parameters
description: Standardized Nextflow pipeline for cross-kingdom soil lipidomics decomposition

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Sample sheet (CSV) for process mode: one row per raw or mzML file with columns file, polarity, role (see docs/usage.md).
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

apply_inputs.title: Apply-mode inputs
apply_inputs.description: Soil data to profile against the atlas. Feature IDs in the intensity table must come from the same alignment as the atlas consensus (same MZmine workflow); data from another method only supports feature-level matching.

soil_intensity.description: Soil feature intensity table (Parquet): one row per feature_id, one column per sample.

soil_mgf.description: Soil MS/MS spectra (MGF) for the same features.

sample_metadata.description: Tab-separated sample metadata with sample_id and treatment columns.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

pipeline_mode_options.title: Pipeline mode
pipeline_mode_options.description: Top-level dispatch — which side of the train/apply split to run.

mode.description: Which workflow to run: `process` (raw files to quality-checked feature tables), `apply` (compare soil data with the Atlas), or `train` (not yet implemented).

atlas_options.title: Reference atlas
atlas_options.description: Reference SIMPER fingerprint + biomarker atlas (published on Zenodo with SHA256 verification).

atlas_doi.description: Zenodo DOI of the reference atlas bundle (filled in at v0.1.0 deposition).

atlas_sha256.description: Pinned SHA256 of the atlas tarball — runtime-asserted by FETCH_ATLAS. Empty until v0.1.0 deposition.

atlas_path.description: Local path to a pre-extracted atlas directory, bypasses the Zenodo fetch (useful for offline/air-gapped runs).

correction_options.title: Quantification correction
correction_options.description: Internal-standard normalisation (L2), the optional experimental RIE correction (L3) and the reference-quality filter (L5).

IS_reference_compound.description: EquiSPLASH component used for L2 normalisation. The paper normalises to PC 15:0–18:1(d7).

IS_spiked_pmol.description: Internal standard spike amount in pmol.

enable_rie.description: Apply the experimental L3 relative-ionisation-efficiency correction. Off by default: it is not part of the published method.

RIE_floor.description: Lower bound on the RIE factor (only with --enable_rie).

restrict_archaea_to_archlips.description: Apply L5 Archaea reference-quality filter (restrict Archaea features to ArchLips-validated set).

simper_top_n.description: Top N SIMPER features retained per phylum when building the fingerprint atlas (train-mode only).

decomposition_options.title: Decomposition
decomposition_options.description: Decomposition methods run in parallel to estimate kingdom-level composition.

decomposition_methods.description: Comma-separated decomposition methods to run in parallel.

primary_method.description: Primary decomposition method reported in the final composition vector (others kept as sensitivity checks).

feature_toggles.title: Runtime feature toggles
feature_toggles.description: Opt-out of optional subworkflows to stay off the critical path.

skip_annotate.description: Skip the ANNOTATE subworkflow (demo default — annotation is parallel enrichment, not a gate for decomposition).

enable_neg.description: Enable negative-mode processing. Out of scope for v0.1 (blocked by missing soil IS); set explicitly to override.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

tuning_options.title: Matching and evaluation tuning
tuning_options.description: Advanced thresholds. Defaults match the paper.

simper_precursor_ppm.description: Precursor m/z tolerance (ppm) for soil-to-atlas MS/MS matching.

simper_fragment_tol.description: Fragment m/z tolerance (Da) for cosine matching.

simper_min_cos.description: Minimum cosine score for a match.

simper_min_matched_peaks.description: Minimum shared fragments for a match.

RIE_ceiling.description: Upper bound on the RIE factor (only with --enable_rie).

fallback_RIE.description: RIE used for classes missing from the RIE table (only with --enable_rie).

archaea_kingdom.description: Kingdom label treated as Archaea by the L5 filter.

min_phylum_samples.description: Minimum reference samples for a phylum to enter decomposition.

diagnostic_top_n.description: Top features per phylum in the diagnostic table.

treatment_contrast.description: Comma-separated treatment levels compared in eval/treatment_effects.tsv. Method-sensitivity check only; not a claim about treatment effects.

process_options.title: Process mode: raw files to quality-checked features
process_options.description: Stages 1-3: conversion, MZmine feature finding and the quality-check report.

thermorawfileparser.description: ThermoRawFileParser command or path, used for .raw inputs.

save_mzml.description: Copy converted mzML files to the output folder.

mzmine_user.description: Path to an MZmine .mzuser login file (MZmine 4 requires a user). Copied into the task; never written to logs.

mzmine_batch_pos.description: MZmine batch settings for positive mode.

mzmine_batch_neg.description: MZmine batch settings for negative mode.

is_targets.description: Internal-standard table (compound, polarity, adduct, mz; optional rt, priority, spike_ng). Default: all 13 EquiSPLASH components; supply your own for other standards.

is_compounds.description: Comma-separated subset of standards from the table to use (default: all).

is_rt_window.description: Window (min) around an expected retention time given in the standards table.

qc_rt_tolerance.description: Maximum internal-standard retention-time deviation (min) in QC injections.

qc_is_rsd.description: Maximum internal-standard peak-area RSD (%) in pooled QCs.

qc_mass_accuracy_ppm.description: Maximum internal-standard mass error (ppm) in QC injections.

qc_feature_rsd.description: Pooled-QC RSD (%) below which a feature counts as reproducible.

qc_feature_pass_fraction.description: Fraction of pooled-QC features that must be reproducible.

qc_blank_ratio.description: Blank-to-sample area ratio above which a feature is reported as blank-influenced.
